title: genista sylvestris subsp. dalmatica
intro: Genista sylvestris subsp. dalmatica, commonly known as Dalmatian broom, is a shrub-like plant in the pea family (Fabaceae). It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and inflammation, due to its health benefits in reducing symptoms and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Dalmatian broom include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help in relaxing muscles, reducing inflammation, and relieving respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Dalmatian broom include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
